## Hosting: GitHub Pages

The pages are hosted on GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc., USA). When you open a page, GitHub processes technically necessary data, including your IP address, to deliver the pages and protect the service. Details: [GitHub Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement).

## Visitor count: GoatCounter

To see which pages are read, this website uses [GoatCounter](https://www.goatcounter.com). GoatCounter

- sets **no cookies** and stores nothing in your browser,
- stores **no IP addresses** and builds no profiles,
- records only: page visited, referring page, browser and operating system, screen size and country (derived from the IP address, which is then not stored).

I only see totals. The legal basis is my legitimate interest in improving the website (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Details: [GoatCounter privacy policy](https://www.goatcounter.com/help/privacy).

Ad blockers may prevent the count.

## Embedded content

Some pages load code libraries and map data from [jsDelivr](https://www.jsdelivr.com) and fonts from Google Fonts (Google Ireland Ltd.). Your IP address is passed to these providers. Calculators and forms on this website run only in your browser; nothing you enter is sent or stored.

## Your rights

You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing and objection (Art. 15–21 GDPR) and the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. To exercise them, write to the address above.
